title: Australian Beach BBQ Shrimp
description: A simple and delicious recipe featuring succulent shrimp, Australian bush tomatoes, and a hint of garlic. Perfect for a beachside BBQ or a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together bush tomatoes, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the mixture.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional bush tomatoes if desired.
Cook time may vary depending on the size of the shrimp.
